description.value: The Whole Bowl is a macro-balanced meal prep kitchen and grab-and-go counter in Surrey specializing in high-protein, nutritionally calibrated rice bowls and wraps designed for fitness and wellness goals. Cyclists can pick up a fresh meal on the spot or pre-order from a rotating menu that accommodates vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, and low-carb needs. The storefront also offers multi-meal prep packages for those planning ahead on longer tours.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides clear evidence of a functioning grab-and-go and meal-prep restaurant in Surrey. The site explicitly lists dietary options (vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, low-carb) and confirms takeout/grab-and-go service. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site. The phone number 604-372-0085 appears in the website footer but was absent from OSM tags.
concerns: Phone number 604-372-0085 found on website footer but was absent from OSM tags — OSM record should be updated with this phone number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating grab-and-go food business with an active website and customer reviews; straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists seeking a quick, nutritious meal in Surrey.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Ordering policy page states meals cater to 'vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, and low-carb options'; a customer review also mentions gluten allergy accommodation
